name: Camera Preconditioning
aliases: Camera Preconditioning for Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A technique to normalize and decorrelate camera parameters during NeRF optimization by transforming the optimization problem from direct camera parameters $\boldsymbol{\phi}_i$ to latent preconditioned parameters $\tilde{\boldsymbol{\phi}}_i$, using a preconditioner matrix $P_i^{-1}$ derived from the covariance of projection derivatives.
